title: RTX Corporation Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were USD 8.305 billion, total debt was USD 37.383 billion, and total backlog was USD 289 billion, including USD 119 billion of defense backlog.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports current backlog, bookings, segment economics, cash flow, balance-sheet liquidity, debt, contract risk, and Pratt powder-metal remediation analysis for RTX.
